system.description: You have an ongoing rivalry with someone — another Toreador, another Cainite, or even a mortal — who takes every opportunity to slander you and advance himself at your expense. A 1-point rival is your own power level and mostly just annoying; a 2-point rival occasionally takes harmful action against you or wields some influence; a 3-point rival has no qualms about attempting real harm. The quarrel can be cooled or ended only with time and effort.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans
